Hi @Alex.Moya , I purchased this model on fab. I sent you an email I would really appreciate your response. My issue is that I work in UE 5 and I opened the prefab in Unity to export an FBX but the exported FBX from the prefab only gives a few animations. I just wanted to request the animations if you have the file available. I have exported the mesh and materials succesfully.

@SakuraNeha If you download the "source.zip" file, you'll download a model that has all the animations combined into one, and you'll have to separate them (I don't know how to do this in Unreal, but I know it's possible in Unity). To get all the animations, I recommend downloading the "lyndswrum_water.unitypackage" file, which has the animations separated, along with other extras. However, that file can only be opened in Unity, although once opened, you can transfer it to Unreal without any problems. Unity is free, by the way.

@Alex.Moya Hi, appreciate the response. Ah ok, now I understand what the source file on FAB contains. Sorry I am a bit of a beginner but yes, as you said I opened it in Unity and was able to export the animations by adding them to one of the prefabs, the model and animations look beautiful in UE5 . I increased the normal values and made its scales pop a bit more, it looks awesome with the realistic lighting and environment. Anyways, great artworks on these dragons/other creatures. I should have checked that it was a Unity Asset, but in the end I am happy it was worth it getting it into UE and I got some experience in Unity as well by learning a bit about it. Thank you :)
